aghanim.scepter: Ghostship creates a fleet of 2 ships at the target point on a 2.5 second interval. Each ship now also fires 3 waves of cannonballs from the port and starboard side that deal 40% of Ghostship's damage as they pass through enemies.
aghanim.shard: Releases a Tidal Wave that spawns behind Kunkka. Deals damage and drags enemies along it. Enemies cannot attack while being dragged.

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.desc: Summons a rising torrent that, after a short delay, hurls enemy units into the sky, stunning, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.

abilities.name: Tidebringer
abilities.desc: Kunkka's legendary sword grants increased damage and cleaves a large area of effect in front of him for a single strike.

abilities.name: X Marks the Spot
abilities.desc: Targets a friendly or enemy Hero, marks their position with an X, and returns them to it after several seconds. Kunkka can trigger the return at any time during the duration. Lasts twice as long on allied heroes.

abilities.name: Tidal Wave
abilities.desc: Releases a Tidal Wave that spawns behind Kunkka. Deals damage and drags enemies along it. Enemies cannot attack while being dragged.

abilities.name: Ghostship
abilities.desc:
Summons a ghostly ship that sails through the battle before smashing apart, damaging and stunning all enemies caught near the wreckage.

Allied heroes touched by the Ghostship are given a 2x strong swig of The Admiral's Rum.

aghanim.scepter: Forces the enemy target to attack Huskar and increases cast range.
aghanim.shard:
Huskar can activate Berserker's Blood for a health cost to cauterize himself. Dispels Huskar, then after a delay, heals for the amount of health consumed plus an additional bonus per debuff dispelled.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

abilities.name: Inner Fire
abilities.desc: In a fiery rage, knocks all nearby enemies away from you to a fixed distance, dealing damage and silencing them.

abilities.name: Burning Spear
abilities.desc: Huskar sets his spears aflame, dealing damage over time with his regular attack. Multiple attacks will stack additional damage. Each attack drains some of Huskar's health.

abilities.name: Berserker's Blood
abilities.desc: Huskar's injuries feed his power, giving increased attack speed, magic resistance and health regen based on missing health. Health regen is a percentage of your strength.

facts.label: CURRENT HP COST — значение с Aghanim's Shard
CAUTERIZE DELAY — значение с Aghanim's Shard
MAX HP HEAL PER DEBUFF — значение с Aghanim's Shard

abilities.name: Life Break
abilities.desc:
Huskar draws upon his health to break an enemy's life, leaping at a target to shatter a percentage of that hero's current health and slow both their movement and attack speed. While leaping, Huskar is Debuff Immune with 60% magic resistance.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

facts.label: TAUNT DURATION — значение с Aghanim's Scepter

aghanim.scepter: Increases bonus movement speed by %bonus_bonus_movement_speed_pct_night% and attack speed by %bonus_bonus_attack_speed_night%. Killing an enemy hero resets all basic ability cooldowns.
aghanim.shard: Void now affects all units in a radius around the target.

abilities.name: Void
abilities.desc: Creates a damaging void that slows an enemy unit and deals damage. At night, Void also mini-stuns, interrupting channeling abilities, and its effects lasts longer.

abilities.name: Crippling Fear
abilities.desc: Night Stalker horrifies all nearby enemies, causing them to become silenced and take damage over time while near him. The effect lasts longer at night.

abilities.name: Hunter in the Night
abilities.desc: Night Stalker is in his element at night, attacking and moving with great swiftness.

facts.label: MOVE SPEED — прибавка от Aghanim's Scepter
ATTACK SPEED — прибавка от Aghanim's Scepter

abilities.name: Dark Ascension
abilities.desc: Night Stalker smothers the sun and summons instant darkness, so that he might use his powers at their fullest. Night Stalker gains flight and bonus damage during this time. Has unobstructed vision.

aghanim.shard: After a short formation time, creates a wall out of kinetic energy that enemies cannot pass.

abilities.name: Thunder Strike
abilities.desc: Repeatedly strikes the targeted unit with lightning. Each strike damages nearby enemy units in a small radius and slows enemy movement and attack speed by 100% for x1.75 seconds. Provides vision of its target.

abilities.name: Glimpse
abilities.desc: Teleports the target hero back to where it was 4 seconds ago. Instantly kills illusions. Deals damage equal to a percentage of the distance glimpsed, that cannot go over a damage maximum.

abilities.name: Kinetic Field
abilities.desc: After a short formation time, creates a circular barrier of kinetic energy that enemies can't pass.

abilities.name: Kinetic Fence
abilities.desc: After a short formation time, creates a wall out of kinetic energy that enemies cannot pass.

abilities.name: Electromagnetic Repulsion
abilities.desc: Whenever Disruptor takes more than 250 damage from any source within 400 radius, all nearby enemies within take damage equal to 1.5x of Disruptor's Intelligence, and are pushed back up to a 400 distance away.

abilities.name: Static Storm
abilities.desc: Creates a damaging static storm that also silences all enemy units in the area for the duration. The damage starts off weak, but increases in power over the duration.

aghanim.scepter: Enchantress roots an enemy unit. All creeps, ally, enemy and neutral within a radius will gain bonus movement and attack speed and attack the chosen target for 6 seconds.
aghanim.shard: Leaps backward, dodges incoming projectiles, and launches an Impetus attack on the 2 furthest enemy units within Enchantress' attack range + 100.

abilities.name: Impetus
abilities.desc: Places an enchantment on each attack while activated, causing it to deal additional damage based on how far away the target is. The farther the target, the greater the damage dealt. Deals double damage to illusions.

abilities.name: Enchant
abilities.desc:
Enchantress charms an enemy. If the enemy is a hero, they are dispelled and slowed for 3.5s, and Enchantress and her units gain bonus attack range against the target.

 If the enemy is a creep, she brings it under her control and receives 40% of their experience bounty. Enchantress can control creeps for up to 30s. 

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

facts.label: MAX ENCHANTED CREEPS — прибавка от Aghanim's Scepter

abilities.name: Nature's Attendants
abilities.desc: A cloud of wisps heals Enchantress and any friendly units nearby.

abilities.name: Sproink
abilities.desc: Leaps backward, dodges incoming projectiles, and launches an Impetus attack on the 2 furthest enemy units within Enchantress' attack range + 100.

abilities.name: Little Friends
abilities.desc: Enchantress roots an enemy unit. All creeps, ally, enemy and neutral within a radius will gain bonus movement and attack speed and attack the chosen target for 6 seconds.

abilities.name: Untouchable
abilities.desc: Enchantress beguiles her enemies, slowing their attacks when she is attacked.

aghanim.shard: Barathrum gains magic resistance and distorts reality around the selected hero, making any unit-targeted spells cast by enemy heroes get redirected towards Spirit Breaker. Can be cast on both allied and enemy heroes, but only spells cast by enemies of Spirit Breaker will be redirected.

abilities.name: Charge of Darkness
abilities.desc:
Spirit Breaker fixes his sight on an enemy unit and starts charging through all objects, starting at 25% of the bonus speed and reaching his max speed after 1.5s.

All enemy units passed through and the targeted unit will be hit by a Greater Bash. If the targeted unit dies, Spirit Breaker will change his target to the nearest enemy unit to that location.

abilities.name: Bulldoze
abilities.desc: Spirit Breaker gains movement speed and status resistance to ram through enemies. Can be used while charging.

abilities.name: Greater Bash
abilities.desc: Gives a chance to stun and knockback an enemy unit on an attack. Deals a percentage of movement speed as damage.

abilities.desc: Barathrum gains magic resistance and distorts reality around the selected hero, making any unit-targeted spells cast by enemy heroes get redirected towards Spirit Breaker. Can be cast on both allied and enemy heroes, but only spells cast by enemies of Spirit Breaker will be redirected.

abilities.name: Empowering Haste
abilities.desc: Spirit Breaker gains bonus Movement Speed for a duration whenever he stuns an enemy. Effects from multiple stuns stack and have independent durations. Duration pauses during Charge of Darkness.

abilities.name: Nether Strike
abilities.desc: Spirit Breaker slips into the nether realm, reappearing next to his hapless victim. Upon reappearing, a Greater Bash of the current level occurs and deals bonus damage. Knocks back for double the normal distance.

abilities.title: Throw Grenade
abilities.description: Throw a grenade at the target area. Enemies in the area will take 50 damage on impact, and be slowed by -15% and take 15 damage every 1s for 5 seconds. Radius 300.

abilities.title: Replenish
abilities.description:
Grants 6 mana regeneration to the target for 25 seconds.

If the unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

items.name: Orb of Blight

abilities.title: Lesser Corruption
abilities.description: Your attacks reduce the target's armor by -2 for 3 seconds.

items.notes: Does not stack with its upgrades, Desolator, or Stygian Desolator.

items.name: Power Treads

abilities.title: Switch Attribute
abilities.description: Switches between +10 Strength, +10 Agility, or +10 Intelligence.

items.notes: Power Treads can be built using a Belt of Strength, Band of Elvenskin, or a Robe of the Magi.

abilities.title: One for the Road
abilities.description: Increases movement speed of all allied units by 10% in a 1000 unit radius around the caster for 6 seconds.

abilities.title: Cold Attack
abilities.description: Attacks lower enemy movement by -25% if they are melee and -50% if they are ranged. Attacks also lower enemy attack speed by -25% and Health Restoration by 50%. Lasts for 3 seconds.

abilities.title: Splitshot
abilities.description: Ranged attacks have a 30% chance to fire additional projectiles at up to 2 nearby enemies with 150 extra range and within a 120 degree angle in front of the attacker. The additional projectiles deal 20 + 75% damage of a normal attack and do not trigger on hit effects. The primary attack deals 20 + 100% damage of a normal attack.
